comparison_framing: Difference vs F13 reflects BOTH representation (raw sample vs 13 features) AND training organization (per-n specialist vs joint). Not attributable to RAW alone.

data_source.note: Chunks concatenate to the gitignored mc_scan_raw.csv; no MDM rerun.

sample_reconstruction.function: generate_sample(beta, eta, gamma, n, repeat_id, seed)

input_contract.input_standardizer: sklearn StandardScaler, per-position, fit on train fold of that n only

label_contract.failure_penalty: p99(valid training loss) from FULL train fold (all n), identical to E3b
label_contract.target_scaling: StandardScaler 26-dim, fit on train fold of that n only

split_contract.folds: deterministic 5-fold full-combo holdout over (beta, gamma/eta, n), identical to E3b

training_contract.checkpoint_resume: per (n, fold, seed) JSON+CSV checkpoint; rerun skips valid checkpoints

boundary: Writes only to artifacts/candidate/E3b_RAW_specialist/. Never modifies artifacts/formal/E3b_vector_mlp/ or sealed E3/E4.

provenance.sha256sums_format: GNU `sha256sum -c` compatible; verify from repo root: `sha256sum -c artifacts/candidate/E3b_RAW_specialist/SHA256SUMS`. Covers source data (45 MDM chunks + MC manifest), code (run_E3b_RAW_specialist.py + config.py + sample.py), and every result file. All covered files are LF-normalized; the manifest references SHA256SUMS by path, not by hash, to avoid a hash cycle.
provenance.note: git_commit/git_commit_short above is the exact code commit checked out when the run executed.
